concepts.proposed_markdown: Adyen authorization adjustment changes the reserved amount on an eligible pre-authorized payment before final capture. For the online card or Klarna paths, it applies only to supported payment methods and Merchant Category Codes, depends on issuer acceptance, and is limited to payments acquired by Adyen. Separately, an in-person Terminal API merchant starts pre-authorization at the terminal, then submits amount updates and capture directly to Adyen's backend. POS eligibility also depends on payment method, scheme, Merchant Category Code and issuer; neither documented path establishes a particular merchant's eligibility or transaction outcome.
